messages:
maya (PM): Morning — planning to ship SDK v24 tomorrow 10:00 PT. Quick coordination thread: who’s deploying, smoke owners, client comms, and rollback steps.

sam (eng): I’ll run the pipeline from the deploy job (us-west-2). Schedule 10:00–10:15 PT. Start at 5% traffic.

alex (runtime): I’ll own runtime canary checks + perf smoke. Plan: warm instances first, then run: ```./scripts/smoke.sh --model=gpt-small --qps=50 --duration=300``` Watch p50/p95 and 5xx.

jordan (devex): I’ll publish SDK packages (npm/pypi) and update docs banner. Will push to the canary channel before GA.

rachel (qa): QA will run full regression at 09:30 PT and smoke at 10:05. Key tests: tokenization edge cases, streaming multipart, auth header handling, cross-version client tests.

li (release): Rollback plan: if error rate >2% or p50 latency +100ms vs baseline for >10m => rollback. Revert traffic to `sdk-v23.9.1` tag and unpublish v24 from canary. I have the rollback commands documented.

sam (eng): Proposed promotion schedule: 5% for 15m -> 25% for 15m -> 100% if green. Agree?

maya (PM): Sounds good. Jordan — please prepare customer comms for dev portal and a short note for #product-announce. Also update the status page.

jordan (devex): @maya will draft now. Stub: "SDK v24: minor API additions, backward compatible. No breaking changes. Deprecations: x-old-client header marked optional." Will post PR for copy.

alex (runtime): Dashboards to watch (placeholder): https://grafana.internal/rdx/sdks/rollout — I’ll monitor KV cache hit rate, token throughput, and tail latency.

sam (eng): Deploy details: using feature flag `sdk_v24_enabled`. Will keep EU regions off for the initial rollout.

rachel (qa): If rollback: steps = 1) flip flag off 2) abort publish jobs 3) revert traffic 4) run smoke on v23 5) notify customers. I’ll stay oncall first hour.

maya (PM): Who’s updating migration guide?

jordan (devex): Jordan + docs team. PR: https://git.internal/rdx/docs/pulls/312 (will add examples and changelog).

sam (eng): Quick ops note: if npm publish fails, fallback = publish to internal registry and repoint CDN.

li (release): Release creds look good. I verified keys and the dry-run yesterday. Keys rotate tomorrow at 18:00 UTC so no overlap.

alex (runtime): If first 5% shows variance I’ll trigger an extra targeted load test: ```tools/loadtest --concurrency 200 --duration 300 --endpoint /v1/generate```

maya (PM): Final check — are you all available 09:30–11:00 PT? Reply with a thumbs-up if you can be on deck.

sam (eng): :thumbsup:

alex (runtime): :thumbsup:

jordan (devex): :thumbsup: will post docs copy before EOD

rachel (qa): :+1: I’ll be at my desk at 09:15 PT

li (release): :thumbsup: I’ll be oncall for the rollback window

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: 2026-03-18T10:00:00-08:00 (us-west-2) — job #deploy-8124 queued.

maya (PM): Thanks — I’ll update the calendar invite and push an owners list + escalation contacts in this thread. If anything changes, call out here and we’ll delay. :heart:
